name: Goan Vegetable Caldine
steps: Cut vegetables to similar size. Lightly toast coriander and cumin for 2 minutes, then grind them finely with turmeric and 100 ml coconut milk to make the mild caldine spice mix.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pot. Cook onion 5 minutes until translucent, not brown; add ginger, garlic and slit green chili and stir for 1 minute.
Add potato, carrot, beans and cauliflower; stir in spice mix, 200 ml water and salt. Cover and simmer 8 minutes until vegetables are almost tender.
Add peas and remaining 400 ml coconut milk. Simmer gently 5–6 minutes until everything is just cooked; avoid a vigorous boil that can split the milk.
Turn off heat, stir in lemon juice and taste salt. Serve this pale golden, mildly spiced coconut curry with steamed rice.
tips: Caldine is a mild yellow coconut curry; keep red chili and deep roasting out of it.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
